mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI annualized increase > 2% does not correlate with negative SPX returns (correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 QoQ decrease > 1% does not correlate with negative SPX returns (correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5pp does not correlate with negative SPX returns (correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO MoM increase > 1% does not correlate with positive SPX returns (correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over the previous 2 months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with positive SPX returns (correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized over the previous 3 months, it signals tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with negative SPX returns (correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points over the previous 3 months, it signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k and UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with positive SPX returns (correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter, coupled with an increase in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months, signals a weakening economy with labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ decrease > 1% and UNRATE increase > 0.5pp in 3 months
regime_hint: economic contraction with labor market stress
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with negative SPX returns (correlation p > 0.05).
